title: The roadmap-refresh routine updates the phase numbers it reads
why: A routine that stops the same way every run does no work and hides that it is broken.
note: Deferred (shiv, Oct 26): rewriting a routine's prompt is your call. Finding, Oct 26 (coordinator): the scheduled roadmap-refresh routine (thread "roadmap refresh", cmsg_01DoF7thf3iq2Srr1UsfXgh2B4z7bjZH8zcikw5sHVdSp6) stopped with no change. It still reads and writes phase numbers in the page's built-in database, which is off now; they live in roadmap/data/meta/phases.json on the roadmap branch, and the routine may not push. Two fixes: (a) it edits phases.json, runs build.py and pushes, and triage republishes; (b) it sends its counts to the triage thread, which files and republishes. Pick: (b), since triage is already the one page publisher and the routine then needs no push grant. Until you pick, every run stops the same way. Placed after c65 (triage, Oct 26): a deferred owner act, small.
